dct_description_sm: The files included here are SAS code provided as documentation for reproducibility of results in the study titled: "Age-period-cohort effects by sex, income, education, immigration status, and race on site-specific cancer incidence in Canada 2006-2021" by Talía Malagón, Mariam El-Zein, Axelle Braggion, Arnaud Chiolero, Darren Brenner, Anita Koushik. Data Source: Statistics Canada, Canadian Census Health and Environment Cohorts 2006 & 2011 & 2016, 2006 long-form census, 2011 National Household Survey, 2016 long-form census, Canadian Vital Statistics Death Database 2006-2021, and Canadian Cancer Registry 2006-2021. This does not constitute an endorsement by Statistics Canada of this product. Statistics Canada is the owner and steward of the data used in this report, and access to the data is regulated by the 1985 Statistics Act. To access the data, researchers must become deemed employees of Statistics Canada and sign a research contract. Members of post-secondary institutions such as a faculty, students, or staff may apply for data access to Statistics Canada microdata through the Research Data Centre program using the Microdata Access Portal (https://www.statcan.gc.ca/en/microdata/data-centres/access).
